id: Kukejar Laras sampai sumur. Ia memanggil seekor kucing dengan nama aslinya, dan kucing itu datang.
en: I chased Laras to the well. She called a stray cat by its real name, and it came.

id: Kami minum teh melati bersama Ibu, lalu kujemput Ciung dan telurnya dari pohon.
en: We had jasmine tea with Ibu, then I fetched Ciung and his egg down from the tree.

id: Di sanggar Laras menulis nama kami di satu lontar. Pasar memperingatkan tentang lelaki bertopeng polos.
en: At the sanggar Laras wrote our names on one lontar. The market warned of a man in a blank mask.

id: Semar mementaskan ruwatan: Batara Kala, Empat Segel, dan nama anak-anak yang dibacakan.
en: Semar played the ruwatan: Batara Kala, the Four Seals, and the children's names read aloud.

id: Bayangan turun dari kelir. Si Pemburu membawa Laras, dan lontar kami robek.
en: The shadows stepped off the screen. The Hunter took Laras, and our lontar tore.

id: Ibu tak ingat Laras, tapi dua cangkir terhidang. Kuambil lontarku dari panggung yang hangus.
en: Ibu doesn't remember Laras, yet two cups were set out. I took my lontar from the burned stage.

id: Semar masih ingat Laras. Ia mengajariku Ka, dan kurapalkan tiga kali.
en: Semar still remembers Laras. He taught me Ka, and I cast it three times.

id: Kuusir para tanpa rupa dari alun-alun.
en: I drove the faceless out of the square.

id: Si Pemburu berdiri di gerbang barat. Ciung lari ke barat, dan para topeng mengikutinya.
en: The Hunter stood at the west gate. Ciung had run west, and the masks followed.

id: Di kebun teh kupatahkan penyergapan dan kutemukan pita Laras di rumpun bambu.
en: On the tea terraces I broke an ambush and found Laras's ribbon in the bamboo.

id: Cepot ada di petilasan. Lalu kupatahkan penyergapan di kampung.
en: Cepot was at the petilasan. Then I broke the ambush in the kampung.

id: Sesepuh kampung melihat Laras berlari bersama bocah liar. Ia mengajariku Ga.
en: The kampung elder saw Laras running with a wild boy. He taught me Ga.

id: Kutemukan sandal, obor padam, dan jejak anak-anak menuju ngarai.
en: I found a sandal, cold torches and children's prints leading into the gorge.

id: Lontar menarikku ke maghrib seorang anak, dan aku belajar menyalakan oncor.
en: The lontar pulled me into a child's maghrib, and I learned to light the oncor.

id: Kukalahkan Sandekala di ngarai. Jejak Laras dan Ciung berpisah di sana.
en: I beat Sandekala in the gorge. Laras's and Ciung's tracks split there.

id: Di Batu Tulis yang dirusak Laras menggores: "Mereka butuh aku membaca." Kupelajari Nga.
en: On the defaced Batu Tulis Laras scratched: "They need me to read." I learned Nga.

id: Penenun menyembunyikan Laras semalam dan memberiku Boeh Rarang.
en: The Weaver hid Laras for a night and gave me the Boeh Rarang.

id: Sungai dibendung, kandang kosong, pohon tumbang: seseorang membangun perahu di danau.
en: A dammed river, empty coops, felled trees: someone is building a boat on the lake.

id: Seorang tanpa rupa menjatuhkan mainan bernama. Mereka dulu manusia.
en: A faceless one dropped a named toy. They were people once.

id: Perempuan di danau mengenali wajah Ciung. Ia mengajariku Ca dan menunjuk kawah.
en: The woman at the lake knew Ciung's face. She taught me Ca and pointed to the crater.

id: Di kawah Laras dipaksa membaca. Ia sengaja membaca pelan, dan aku mendengar suaranya.
en: At the crater Laras was made to read. She read slowly on purpose, and I heard her voice.

id: Kukalahkan Kapten Tanpa Rupa, tapi ia sempat memecahkan segel. Kutemukan pecahan topeng kedua.
en: I beat the Faceless Captain, but he cracked the seal first. I found a second mask fragment.

id: Lontar menarikku ke malam Dayang Sumbi: kain putih, lesung, fajar palsu.
en: The lontar pulled me into Dayang Sumbi's night: white cloth, lesung, a false dawn.

id: Fajar palsu mengakhiri Sangkuriang sekali lagi. Ciung dan Nagawiru bebas, dan telur menetas.
en: A false dawn ended Sangkuriang again. Ciung and Nagawiru are free, and the egg hatched.

id: Di keramaian sayembara Galuh, Ciung dan aku menyusun rencana.
en: In Galuh's tournament crowd, Ciung and I made a plan.

id: Kumenangkan kedua babak; ayam Ciung menang di balik tembok.
en: I won both bouts; Ciung's rooster won behind the wall.

id: Uwa Lengser membuka istana dalam. Ia melihat mata seorang ratu pada Ciung.
en: Uwa Lengser opened the inner palace. He saw a queen's eyes in Ciung.

id: Aku terlambat: kereta Laras lolos ke timur, tapi ia melempar helai bertanda Ka.
en: I was too late: Laras's wagon escaped east, but she threw me a strip marked Ka.

id: Di dinding sel Laras menulis: "Seribu candi. Jangan berhenti."
en: On the cell wall Laras wrote: "The thousand temples. Don't stop."

id: Kudengar Laras di bawah kain kereta; ia menitip pesan untuk Ibu soal cangkir.
en: I heard Laras under the wagon cloth; she left a message for Ibu about the cup.

id: Nasib si pembelot diputuskan, dan potret raja di galeri sudah dikikis habis.
en: The deserter's fate was decided, and the king's portrait in the gallery was scraped bare.

id: Ingatan Lengser: seorang lelaki mencoba wajah raja. Pecahan topeng ketiga di dekat takhta.
en: Lengser's memory: a man trying on the king's face. A third mask fragment lay by the throne.

id: Kubuka topeng Barma Wijaya. Ia mengaku memberikan namanya yang dulu pada Kala, dan nama itu si Pemburu.
en: I unmasked Barma Wijaya. He confessed he gave his old name to Kala, and that name is the Hunter.

id: Di pasar sungai dua perekrut menceritakan perang yang sama secara terbalik. Kulewati gerbang perbatasan.
en: At the river market two recruiters told the same war backwards. I passed the border gate.

id: Tiga petunjuk tentang Laras: pasar, reruntuhan, kuburan.
en: Three leads on Laras: the market, the ruins, the graveyard.

id: Kupelajari Ha dari Ki Sumarto, Na dari dasar Arca, dan Ca dari perempuan lesung.
en: I learned Ha from Ki Sumarto, Na from the Arca's base and Ca from the lesung women.

id: Di kuburan si Pemburu bilang dua pasukan membuat dua kali lupa. Pecahan keempat menunjukkan harga namanya.
en: At the graves the Hunter said two armies make twice the forgetting. A fourth fragment showed what his name cost.

id: Blokade runtuh, dan juru kunci memberiku Ra serta membuka tangga candi.
en: The blockade fell, and the juru kunci gave me Ra and opened the temple stairs.

id: Perkemahan di Candi Seribu ternyata ruang baca. Laras sudah dibawa ke timur.
en: The camp at Candi Seribu was a reading room. Laras had been taken east.

id: Puing, lesung yang ditinggalkan, helai Ka Laras: semuanya menunjuk satu kisah lama.
en: Rubble, an abandoned lesung, Laras's Ka strip: all pointed to one old tale.

id: Lontar menarikku ke para dayang sang putri, dan aku belajar irama lesung.
en: The lontar pulled me to the princess's women, and I learned the lesung beat.

id: Laras terpaksa membaca di ruang baca. Ia menulis Ka lagi.
en: Laras was forced to read in the reading room. She wrote Ka again.

id: Dengan irama dan Ca, malam Bandung Bondowoso berakhir.
en: With the beat and Ca, Bandung Bondowoso's night ended.

id: Di batu Pamali kutuliskan nama Nagawiru, nama pertama yang kutulis untuk orang lain.
en: On the Pamali stone I wrote Nagawiru's name, the first name I ever wrote for someone.

id: Ki Sumarto memainkan dua saudara yang membelah tanah, dan aku belajar arti pamali.
en: Ki Sumarto played two brothers who split the land, and I learned what pamali means.

id: Kubaca surat-surat Hariang Banga untuk ibunya, lalu berduel dengannya di tepi penyeberangan.
en: I read Hariang Banga's letters to his mother, then fought him at the ford.

id: Di jalan para pandai besi kutemui putri sang empu, lalu kupatahkan penyergapan di perbatasan.
en: On the smiths' street I met the smith's daughter, then broke the border ambush.

id: Tanda kutukan merah membawaku ke Mpu Wirasana, yang mengajariku mematahkannya.
en: Red curse marks led me to Mpu Wirasana, who taught me to break them.

id: Sang janda kehilangan putrinya, Timun Mas. Kutemukan biji, jarum, garam, dan terasi.
en: The widow lost her daughter Timun Mas. I found the seeds, needles, salt and terasi.

id: Lontar menarikku menjadi Timun Mas yang lari dari seorang raksasa.
en: The lontar pulled me into Timun Mas running from a giant.

id: Kukalahkan Buto Ijo, yang dibuat gila oleh kutukan keris.
en: I beat Buto Ijo, driven mad by the keris's curse.

id: Kupatahkan dua tanda latihan dan menemukan sarung keris patah serta catatan tempa Wirasana.
en: I broke two practice marks and found the broken scabbard and Wirasana's forge records.

id: Kuikuti jejak abu si Pemburu menyusuri pesisir dan Lautan Pasir.
en: I followed the Hunter's ash trail down the coast and across the Sea of Sand.

id: Laras mencoba menggambar wajahku di pasir dan tak bisa. Ia hanya menulis Ka.
en: Laras tried to draw my face in the sand and couldn't. She only wrote Ka.

id: Di candi gurun kulihat Laras membaca. Ingatan bengkel tua mengajariku memadamkan kutuk, dan keris itu tenang.
en: At the desert shrine I saw Laras reading. A memory of the old forge taught me to douse the curse, and the keris quieted.

id: Pecahan terakhir menunjukkan penyerbuan lewat mata si Pemburu. Pecahan-pecahan menyatu menjadi satu topeng.
en: The last fragment showed the raid through the Hunter's eyes. The fragments joined into one mask.

id: Kuhadapi si Pemburu dan kukembalikan nama Aria Kebonan. Lalu Gerhana mengambil Laras.
en: I faced the Hunter and gave back the name Aria Kebonan. Then the Eclipse took Laras.

id: Pasukan berkuda Hariang Banga membawaku pulang ke Desa Purwa di bawah Gerhana.
en: Hariang Banga's riders carried me home to Desa Purwa under the Eclipse.

id: Kutuliskan nama tiga keluarga di tiang pintu mereka.
en: I wrote three families' names on their doorposts.

id: Kubawakan Ibu pita, papan, dan helai Ka milik Laras. Ia menata cangkir kedua dengan benar.
en: I brought Ibu Laras's ribbon, board and Ka strip. She set the second cup straight.

id: Ciung dan Hariang makan di meja ibuku sebagai saudara.
en: Ciung and Hariang ate at my mother's table as brothers.

id: Semar bilang ia dewa yang memilih menjadi abdi, dan menyuruhku ke selatan.
en: Semar told me he is a god who chose to be a servant, and sent me south.

id: Di pantai pasir hitam Mbah Wiryo mengajariku tata krama laut.
en: On the black-sand shore Mbah Wiryo taught me the sea's manners.

id: Kukumpulkan tiga bait lagu laut dari tiga keluarga.
en: I gathered three verses of the sea song from three families.

id: Lontar menunjukkan istri Wiryo mengajarinya memanggil nama ke dalam air.
en: The lontar showed Wiryo's wife teaching him to call a name into the water.

id: Kuseberangi karang.
en: I crossed the reef.

id: Di kuil tebing kudengar ratu selatan dituturkan sebagai satu kisah di antara banyak.
en: At the cliff shrine I heard the queen of the south told as one tale among many.

id: Laras mengikuti suara di atas air. Laut masih menyebut namanya.
en: Laras followed a voice on the water. The sea still says her name.

id: Kujalani Ujian Ombak dan menerima Ombak serta Kain Hijau.
en: I passed the Trial of the Waves and received Ombak and the Kain Hijau.

id: Di mulut gua kuputar ulang kejar-kejaran dan merebut La.
en: At the cave mouth I replayed the tag game and won back La.

id: Kuhancurkan dua penangkal waktu di Pasir Jam Pasir.
en: I shattered two time-wards on the Hourglass Sands.

id: Di Jurang Lupa kuputar ulang dua cangkir dan merebut Ra.
en: In the Abyss of Forgetting I replayed the two cups and won back Ra.

id: Di petilasan terakhir kuputar ulang nama-nama yang ditulis dan merebut Sa.
en: At the last petilasan I replayed the written names and won back Sa.

id: Semar menceritakan Murwakala: Kala lapar, bukan jahat.
en: Semar told the tale of Murwakala: Kala is hungry, not wicked.

id: Laras di dasar kegelapan melupakanku, tapi tangannya masih menulis Ka.
en: Laras at the bottom of the dark forgot me, but her hand still wrote Ka.

id: Aku menjadi dalang di kelir Semar dan membacakan nama-nama.
en: I became the dalang at Semar's kelir and read the names.

id: Kutenangkan Batara Kala dengan Ruwatan Fajar.
en: I calmed Batara Kala with the Dawn Ruwatan.

id: Kutuliskan La-Ra-Sa, dan Laras pulang.
en: I wrote La-Ra-Sa, and Laras came home.

id: Kembali kepada Ki Darsa
en: Return to Ki Darsa

id: Lapor kepada kepala desa
en: Report to the village head
